entities.name: HIV-1 gp160 Env
observations: 768-aa sequence matches reviewed HIV-1 Env gp160 references at about 72–73% identity and full query coverage; sequence includes ambiguous X residues.
Pfam detects GP120 (PF00516) at residues 33–510 and GP41 (PF00517) at 529–720.
Reference annotation: glycosylated gp160 precursor is furin-cleaved into gp120 and gp41; gp120 mediates CD4/coreceptor binding and gp41 mediates class-I viral membrane fusion.
Predicted/reference localization includes virion and host-cell/endosomal membranes; Env forms trimers.
